pages.title: Hydro Mining Rig
pages.text: The highest-tier mining rig, capable of mining the most advanced veins.$(br2)Not consuming electricity, but each mining operation consumes 1000 mB of water $(efu)$(br)Speed: 1 item pre 3 seconds $(br)Mines: all vein types including advanced exclusive veins

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Hydro Mining Rig require water for extraction, which can be transported through fluid pipes.$(br2)Like the previous mining rigs, the products will be automatically submitted to the Global Storage.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
